sections.title: Agreeing to things
sections.content: *Rendben* ("okay / alright") agrees to a plan or request. *Persze* ("of course") confirms something more naturally, the way English sometimes prefers "sure" over a flat "yes".

items.english: Can you wait five minutes? – Okay.

sections.content: *Rendben* on its own is one of the most useful one-word replies in everyday Hungarian — it closes off a small negotiation (times, favors, plans) the way English "deal" or "sure thing" does.
